feeds.readOnly: Events from a URL can't be changed here, and the calendar can't be shared. Its events are signed by this server, not by a person.

events.deleteDescription: The event is deleted for good.

settings.title: Settings
settings.thisDevice: These settings are kept on this device.

grid.moved: Moves to {{start}} until {{end}}. Enter to open, Escape to cancel.

reminders.title: Calendar reminder
reminders.banner: Kutup Calendar needs your permission to show desktop notifications for event reminders.

picker.repeats: The same notification twice: change or remove one.

settings.title: Desktop notifications
settings.denied: Notifications are turned off for Calendar in this browser. Allow them in the browser's site settings.
settings.allowed: Reminders show as desktop notifications while Calendar is open.
settings.push: Remind me when Calendar is closed
settings.pushHint: The reminder says only when an event starts; its title shows once Calendar opens.

sharing.title: Share {{name}}
sharing.description: People you share with get the calendar's key, sealed to their account: only they can read it. Links are for anyone else.
sharing.presetHint: You can change or remove what people can do at any time.
sharing.removeDescription: They keep what they could already see, but nothing new: the calendar gets a new key, shared with everyone who stays.
sharing.removeAnyway: Remove, and share the new key with them anyway

removeDoubt.changed: {{address}} stays, and their identity changed since you last shared with them. The new key would go to the account Kutup finds now.
removeDoubt.invalid: {{address}} stays, but their keys aren't signed by their account. The new key would go to the keys their server lists.
removeDoubt.someoneElse: {{address}} now leads to someone else. The new key would go to whoever has that address now.

sharing.leaveDescription: You won't see it any more. Its owner can invite you again.

errors.notFound: There's no Kutup account at {{address}}. Check the address.
errors.otherServer: {{address}} is on another server. Calendars are shared with people on this server for now; share a link instead.
errors.already: {{address}} already has this calendar, or an invitation to it.
errors.tooMany_one: A calendar can be shared with {{count}} person.
errors.tooMany_other: A calendar can be shared with {{count}} people.

links.description: Anyone with a link can see the calendar, without a Kutup account. Delete a link to stop it working.
links.createDescription: Choose what the link shows. You can delete it at any time.

busy.name: Busy times only
busy.hint: When you're busy, nothing more: no titles, places or descriptions.
busy.after: Anyone with this link sees when you're busy, nothing more.

full.name: All event details
full.hint: The calendar's key is in the link, after the #, which never reaches the server: it opens the events in the browser.
full.after: Anyone with this link sees every event. Kutup's server can't read it.

query.name: All event details, for other calendar apps
query.hint: For apps that subscribe to a calendar address. The key goes to the server with every fetch.
query.after: Calendar apps with this address see every event, read by the server on each fetch.
query.warning: With this kind of link, the server opens the calendar each time an app fetches it, so it sees your events then. Use it only for apps that need it.

copy.ics: Copy the address for calendar apps

links.copyFailed: It couldn't be copied: select it and copy it yourself.
links.deleteDescription: It stops working for everyone who has it.
links.label: Label (optional)
links.labelHint: Only you can see the label.

preset.edit: You can see and edit its events.

changed.title: {{address}}'s identity changed
changed.body: The account that sent this isn't the one you met before as {{address}}. Join only if you know why (they set their account up again).

invalid.title: {{address}}'s keys aren't signed
invalid.body: Their keys aren't signed by their account, so Kutup can't tell who sent this.

someoneElse.title: {{address}} is someone else now
someoneElse.body: This address belonged to someone you met before; the invitation comes from someone else.

ownerChanged.title: {{address}}'s identity changed
ownerChanged.body: A calendar shared with you by {{address}} stays closed: the account behind the address is not the one you met before. Trust the new one only if you know why it changed.

replaceLinks.intro_one: This calendar has {{count}} link with its key:
replaceLinks.intro_other: This calendar has {{count}} links with its key:
replaceLinks.label: Also replace links
replaceLinks.hint: They are deleted and made again under new keys, so anyone the removed person gave them to loses access. You get the new addresses.
replaceLinks.doneDescription: The old links no longer work. Give these to whoever should keep seeing the calendar.
replaceLinks.notRemade: The key changed and the old links were removed, but these couldn't be made again. Make them again from Links:

due.title: Change the key of {{name}}
due.description: Someone who had this calendar's key no longer has the calendar. A new key goes to everyone who still has it:
due.doubt: Not everyone here is someone you already know. Check the list before you go on: the new key goes to exactly these people.

busy.shareHint: People in your organization can see when you're busy from this calendar: times only, never what or where.

publicLink.fullNote: Shared by link. The calendar opened in this browser: Kutup's server can't read it.
publicLink.busyNote: Shared by link: when its owner is busy, nothing more.

forApps.title: This link is for calendar apps
forApps.body: Add it to a calendar app that subscribes to calendar addresses; it doesn't open here.

gone.title: This link doesn't work any more
gone.body: Its owner deleted it, or it never existed. Ask them for a new one.

incomplete.title: This link is incomplete
incomplete.body: The part after the # is missing, and the calendar can't be opened without it. Copy the whole link again.

unreadable.title: This calendar can't be opened
unreadable.body: The link may have been changed on the way. Copy the whole link again, or ask its owner for a new one.

errors.events: The events couldn't be loaded. Try again.

recurrence.deleteThis: Would you like to delete this event?
recurrence.deleteAll: Would you like to delete all the events in this series?
recurrence.updateWhich: Which event would you like to update?
recurrence.updateThis: Would you like to update this event?
recurrence.updateAll: Would you like to update all events in this series?
recurrence.modificationsLost: Previous modifications on this series will be lost.
recurrence.invalid: This repeat doesn't fit the event's start. Choose another.

import.title: Import events
import.intro: You can import events in iCal format (ICS file). The file should have a maximum size of {{size}} and have up to {{count}} events. If your file is bigger, please split it into smaller files.
import.invitation_one: This file contains an event invitation.
import.invitationResponse_one: This file contains an invitation response.
import.invitationHint: Imported invitations appear in Kutup Calendar as simple events without organizer and participant details. To get event updates and see participants, ask organizers to invite you using your Kutup email address.
import.partialIntro: This file contains some data that we cannot import:
import.unsupported: Kutup Calendar currently does not support certain event types, details and formats.
import.noneImportable: No event can be imported. Expand for details.
import.someUnsupported: Part of your calendar content is not supported and will not be imported.
import.discarded_one: {{discarded}} out of {{count}} event will not be imported. Expand for details.
import.discarded_other: {{discarded}} out of {{count}} events will not be imported. Expand for details.
import.dontClose: Please don't close the tab before the importing process is finished.
import.progress: Encrypting and adding events to your calendar: {{imported}}/{{count}}
import.success_one: Event successfully imported. The imported event will now appear in your calendar.
import.success_other: Events successfully imported. The imported events will now appear in your calendar.
import.partialSuccess_one: An error occurred while encrypting and adding your event. {{imported}} out of {{count}} event successfully imported.
import.partialSuccess_other: An error occurred while encrypting and adding your events. {{imported}} out of {{count}} events successfully imported.
import.noneImported_one: An error occurred while encrypting and adding your event. No event could be imported.
import.noneImported_other: An error occurred while encrypting and adding your events. No event could be imported.
import.done_one: {{imported}}/{{count}} event encrypted and added to your calendar
import.done_other: {{imported}}/{{count}} events encrypted and added to your calendar

file.noFileSelected: An error occurred uploading your file. No file has been selected.

file.fileTooBig: An error occurred uploading your file {{filename}}. Maximum file size is {{size}}.
file.invalidCalendar: Your file {{filename}} is not a calendar.
file.invalidMethod: Your file {{filename}} has an invalid method and cannot be imported.
file.noEvents: Your file {{filename}} has no events to be imported.
file.tooManyEvents_one: Your file {{filename}} contains more than {{count}} event.
file.tooManyEvents_other: Your file {{filename}} contains more than {{count}} events.
